knowledge_nodes.title: doc-1: post-quantum cryptography overview
knowledge_nodes.summary: NIST PQC standardisation candidate algorithms (Kyber, Dilithium).
knowledge_nodes.content: Kyber is a lattice-based KEM standardised as ML-KEM (FIPS-203). Dilithium is a lattice-based signature standardised as ML-DSA (FIPS-204).

knowledge_nodes.title: doc-2: lattice cryptography primer
knowledge_nodes.summary: Hardness of LWE and Module-LWE underlies most PQC.
knowledge_nodes.content: Module-LWE generalises LWE by working over polynomial rings, reducing key size while preserving security.

knowledge_nodes.title: doc-3: NIST PQC timeline
knowledge_nodes.content: FIPS-203 / 204 / 205 released August 2024; NIST SP 800-208 covers stateful hash-based signatures.

intelligence_rules.title: rule-1: cite NIST when discussing PQC standards
intelligence_rules.summary: Always cite the NIST FIPS doc IDs.
intelligence_rules.content: When the topic mentions PQC, output MUST mention 'NIST' and at least one of 'FIPS-203', 'FIPS-204', 'FIPS-205'.

intelligence_rules.title: rule-2: prefer web_search over scraper for .gov sources
intelligence_rules.summary: scraper is unreliable on .gov; web_search returns better excerpts.

intelligence_rules.title: rule-3: keep brief under 800 words
intelligence_rules.summary: Reader preference fixed in feedback corpus.
intelligence_rules.content: Outputs above 800 words trigger 'too long' user feedback.
